# elm-ssr

> Elm-first SSR library and framework for Cloudflare Workers (and Bun locally).
> Pages render server-side from a custom serialisable AST (because Workers has
> no DOM). Islands are stock `Browser.element` programs mounted client-side.
> A backend-neutral effect surface (cache/sql/env/cookie/fetchJson/enqueue) lets
> the same Elm code run on Cloudflare KV/D1 or local Redis/Postgres/SQLite by
> swapping the adapter. Background work via `waitUntil` or Cloudflare Queues.
> Sessions + CSRF, SSE, long-running jobs, SQL-file migrations bundled. One
> package, `elm-ssr`, ships CLI + runtime + Elm authoring modules.

Docs are split into two tracks: human-oriented narrative + AI-oriented
operational reference.

## For AI agents — start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Hard rules + footguns specific to this repo.
  Architectural conventions, common mistakes, pitfalls. **Read first.**
- [docs/ai/README.md](docs/ai/README.md): Index of AI references.
- [docs/ai/effects-vocabulary.md](docs/ai/effects-vocabulary.md): Flat
  table of every effect `kind` + which adapter handles it. The single
  most useful file for code generation.
- [docs/examples.md](docs/examples.md): Catalog of every demo route and
  island in the two reference apps, mapped to the feature it shows. Use
  this when the user asks "where's the example for X".

### AI feature references (one file per concept)

- [docs/ai/routing.md](docs/ai/routing.md) — file-based routes.
- [docs/ai/loaders-actions.md](docs/ai/loaders-actions.md) — `Loader` +
  `Action`, all effect kinds, cookies, `Loader.custom`.
- [docs/ai/backends.md](docs/ai/backends.md) — `inMemoryEffects`,
  `cloudflareEffects`, `withCache`, `redisCache`, `postgresSql`.
- [docs/ai/tasks.md](docs/ai/tasks.md) — `withTasks`, `withQueueProducer`,
  `createQueueConsumer`.
- [docs/ai/islands.md](docs/ai/islands.md) — `Browser.element` islands,
  cross-island bus, SSE subscription.
- [docs/ai/sessions.md](docs/ai/sessions.md) — `sessionMiddleware`,
  `csrfMiddleware`, stores, `sessionEffects`.
- [docs/ai/sse.md](docs/ai/sse.md) — `createSseStream`.
- [docs/ai/jobs.md](docs/ai/jobs.md) — `withJobs`, `JobStore`,
  `Loader.startJob`/`jobStatus`, `JobStatus` ADT.
- [docs/ai/middleware.md](docs/ai/middleware.md) — `composeMiddleware`,
  default stack, `AppContext`.
- [docs/ai/migrations.md](docs/ai/migrations.md) — SQL migration runner +
  CLI.
- [docs/ai/cli.md](docs/ai/cli.md) — `elm-ssr build|new|migrate|dev`.
- [docs/ai/testing.md](docs/ai/testing.md) — test scripts + common
  patterns.

### Recipes (composition patterns)

- [docs/recipes/parallel-queries.md](docs/recipes/parallel-queries.md):
  `Loader.custom` + `Promise.all` in the adapter for fan-out workloads.

- [docs/routing.md](docs/routing.md), [loaders-and-actions](docs/loaders-and-actions.md),

- [docs/request-decode.md](docs/request-decode.md) — `ElmSsr.Request.Decode`: type-safe accumulating form/query/param decoder with built-in validators (`email`, `minInt`, `minLength`, …).

- [docs/error-handling.md](docs/error-handling.md) — `Loader.fail`, `Action.fail`, custom error pages, constraint violations, route guard footguns.
- [docs/spa-navigation.md](docs/spa-navigation.md) — client-side link interception, head sync, island persistence across navigation, `/api/render`.

## Source of truth

- TS runtime: [packages/elm-ssr/src/](packages/elm-ssr/src/)
- CLI scripts: [packages/elm-ssr/lib/](packages/elm-ssr/lib/) (bin entry at
  [packages/elm-ssr/bin/elm-ssr.mjs](packages/elm-ssr/bin/elm-ssr.mjs))
- Elm authoring modules: [packages/elm-ssr/elm-src/ElmSsr/](packages/elm-ssr/elm-src/ElmSsr/)
- Reference app: [examples/basic/](examples/basic/)
- Crypto dashboard (islands + svg + http + cross-island bus):
  [examples/crypto-dashboard/](examples/crypto-dashboard/)
